Local changes: validate Get VCP replies (header, result, feature and checksum); add `read volume` returning current and maximum in one transaction; send full fixed-length request packets even when trailing bytes are zero; use 50ms DDC waits for slower firmware; correct the uint16_t extraction buffer length. Original MIT license retained.

0.2.0: read replies at offset 0 with 11-byte length; include source address in Get VCP request checksum, per VESA DDC/CI framing; classify valid null replies separately; optional byte trace via SCREENVOLUME_DDC_TRACE; set minimum deployment target to macOS 14.2. Regression tests cover read address/length and the standard volume request checksum. These corrections did not resolve the current BenQ connection; software audio mode is provided separately.
